description_en: Retrieves the current generation status of an identity and access governance report
description_zh: 获取身份权限治理检测报告当前的生成状态
name: GetGovernanceReportStatus

GovernanceItemStatus.description_en: An array of objects, each representing the generation status of a specific governance item
GovernanceItemStatus.description_zh: 报告中单项的生成状态，为一个数组。数组中的每一行表明某治理项报告的生成状态

GovernanceItem.description_en: The name of the governance item

Status.description_en:
The generation status of the governance item. Valid values:

Started: Generation for this governance item has started.

Progressing: This governance item is being processed.

Completed: Processing for this governance item is complete
Status.description_zh:
治理项报告的生成状态，取值：

Started：治理报告开始生成。
Progressing：治理报告生成中。
Completed：治理报告已生成

WholeReportStatus.description_en:
The overall generation status of the report. Valid values:

Started: The report generation has started.

Progressing: The report is being generated.

Completed: The report has been generated
WholeReportStatus.description_zh:
报告的生成状态。取值：

Started：治理报告开始生成。
Progressing：治理报告生成中。
Completed：治理报告已经生成
